2. The learned Advocate for the present petitioner Mr. Sonkar Chandra Das took the court to the application for injunction and submitted that the petitioner filed Title Suit No. 8 of 1959 for partition in the 1st Court of Munsif, Bhola contending, inter alia, that the land of C.S Khatian No.922 belonged to Sarada Rani Das, jamini Das, Chandra Kumar Das, Unesh Chandra Das; That Chandra Kumar Das died leaving the only heir son Profulla Kumar Das who is the present petitioner, Title Suit No.8 of 1959 was decreed on compromise by the judgment and decree dated 3.2.1960 against defendant Nos.1-3 rest on compromise and ex-parte against the rest. When the application for drawing up final decree in  Title Suit No.8 of 1995 was rejected on 14.9.1992 the petitioner filed a revision application of 14.9.1992 in Civil Revision No. 447 of 1993 and the Rule was made absolute and as per direction of the High Court Division the trial court made the preliminary decree final on 31.8.1998. 

 6. It is stated in Para 13 that the Opposite Parties No. 1-4 and others filed Title Suit No. 221 of 2003 in the Court of Assistant Judge Charfession, Bhola for permanent injunction for 2.00 acres of land from S.A Khatian No. 472 and 473 the present petitioner was not made a party but his son Parimal Chandra Das and three others were made defendants and Parimal Chandra Das son of this petitioner filed a petition under Order 7 Rule 11(D) of the Code of Civil Procedure for rejection of the plaint and the petition was allowed and the plaint was rejected by judgment dated 9.3.2005 in favour of the present petitioner. 

 7. It is alleged that the opposite parties in the injunction petition tried to dispossess this petitioner from the decreetal land and Parimal Chandra Das lodged a GDE No. 386 dated 10.8.2007 with the Charfession Police Station and in Title Suit No. 28 of 1959 the plaintiff got separate Shaham of 3.041/2 decimals of land of S.A Khatian No.473, 3.391/2 decimals of I and from S.A. Khatian No.472 and the full description of the land has been given in Chitta Khaian and in total the plaintiff got 6.44 acres of land in the final decree with full delivery of possession through court. The opposite parties again threatened the present petitioner to dispossess and GDE No.428 dated 27.12.2007 was lodged with the same police station. 

 new application for temporary injunction when Profulla Kumar Das got the delivery of possession in different mouzas and different khatians numbers and Plot numbers and it is not a fit case for granting temporary injunction.
